column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the oracle” is rendered “The burden,” and NKJV places the clause about “the eye of man” in parentheses.
Close to the Hebrew; “for it is very wise” is rendered “though they are very wise.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a fortification” is rendered “a tower,” and “the mud” “the mire.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Lord will dispossess her” is rendered “the LORD will cast her out,” and “her wealth” “her power.”
NKJV renders “her object of confidence will be ashamed” as “He dried up her expectation,” and “will not remain” as “shall not be inhabited.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a mixed population” is rendered “A mixed race.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a chief (clan)” is rendered “a leader.”
NKJV renders “[as] a guard, from one who passes” as “Because of the army, Because of him who passes by,” reading the word as “army.”
Close to the Hebrew; “victorious (saved)” is rendered “having salvation,” and “poor” “Lowly.”
Close to the Hebrew; the futures “I will bend … I will fill” are rendered as past, “I have bent … Fitted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the ram’s horn” is rendered “the trumpet.”
NKJV renders “they will devour and tread down the sling stones” as “They shall devour and subdue with slingstones,” and supplies “with blood” for “they will be full like bowls.”
Close to the Hebrew; “stones of a crown sparkling on his land” is rendered “the jewels of a crown, Lifted like a banner over His land.”
